role: AI-authored fixed SOFTWARE VERIFICATION fixture; not student final research design or competition proof

metrics.zero_denominator_policy: value null; denominator_zero true; preserve numerator and denominator; no pass by fiat

source_policy: Explicit actual geometry.src object passed to current audited solver.forward(src=source, save=False, dt=fixed_dt); retain raw source/time/receiver records before and after. No cell-volume normalization added; identical spacing/source in all cases. This is not absolute physical amplitude calibration.
reference_scope: Physical image-path travel times are continuum geometric estimates, not rigorous discrete causality bounds. Fourth-order stencils and finite-sampled Ricker wavelets have tails. Both references and complete raw traces are retained for an empirical reference-window check; no perfectly clean window is asserted. Changing nbl also changes exterior return paths and spreading; these trace-difference norms are not intrinsic absorber reflection coefficients.

memory.other_memory: Halos, model arrays, compiler and Python/Devito process memory are additional; record actual logical and halo shape/bytes.

publication: Exclusive new output directory; retain running/failed status and all attempted cases; completion receipt published atomically only after all seven cases/raw arrays and source checks. Existing output is never reused.
physics_limits: One homogeneous source band and geometry only; same-code enlarged-box truncation diagnostic.
No certificate transfer, free-surface/PML validation, independent-geology evidence, inversion advantage or final scientific conclusion.

matched_exterior_controls.scope: Same padded stencil grid shape and translated source/receiver grid nodes; vary damping only. Record all differences against reference321 and direct paired traces. Paired normalizers are the undamped-control norms, with numerator/denominator retained.
